subject: [Marketplace] Co-sell demo & integration retainer — CloudScale
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tran <michael.tran@acme.software>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the time last week. CloudScale is ready to move our integration into a marketplace-ready state and we'd like to engage Redwood for a short engineering retainer (2 weeks) to help with demo routing, entitlement mapping, and the private-offer SKU flows for AWS & GCP.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm the minimum evidence bundle for a cross-cloud listing (security & billing artifacts).
- Help map CloudScale pricing tiers to Redwood SKU/entitlement model.
- A demo tenant or staging route so our presales team can run co-sell demos.

I attached our initial MA and a simple scoping doc. Can we set up a brief call with engineering and channel ops this week?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Partnerships | CloudScale Solutions
[Attachment: CloudScale_MA.pdf (24KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the heads up and the MA. Short answer: yes, we can support a 2-week integration retainer and deliver the demo routing + SKU mapping.

Proposed immediate plan (mutual action plan):
1) Evidence intake (this week) — we'll validate the security artifacts and list any gaps.
2) Demo tenant + routing (days 1–3) — Olga will provision a staging route and a demo tenant for your presales.
3) Entitlement mapping (days 4–7) — Ben and I will workshop pricing -> SKU mappings and private-offer flows.
4) Engineering retainer (days 8–14) — we allocate 20 engineer-hours/week to implement routing/telemetry fixes and run a final test.

Can you confirm: who on your billing side owns SKU/pricing (CC me + Michael)? Also, attach the billing matrix or pricing tiers if available — I added a stub SOW spreadsheet to this thread for scope and rates.

Proposed times for a kickoff call: Tue 6/22 10:00am PT or Wed 6/23 2:00pm PT — whichever works for your team.

Best,
Monica Patel
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-retainer-outline.xlsx (8KB)]

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tran <michael.tran@acme.software>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer

Thanks Monica —

Wed 6/23 2:00pm PT works for us. Michael (cc) handles pricing; I'm looping him in to share the tier file. Attaching the MA again and a one-page pricing matrix for quick reference. We're open to the proposed retainer cadence.

Quick notes:
- We do expect a couple of security evidence items (TLS cert chain, data retention policy, SOC-2 summary). I can drop those in the Drive folder by EOD.
- For the demo tenant, we need a short-lived private-offer path thatPresales can use without impacting prod.

See you on Wednesday.

—Sarah
[Attachment: CloudScale_pricing_onepage.pdf (6KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS SellWith <aws-sellwith@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer

Sarah / Monica —

Great kickoff earlier. A few operational items I'll own:
- SKU mapping template (attached) — please populate your tier IDs against Redwood's SKU namespace so we can validate private-offer logic.
- Billing routing question: do you plan to use AWS Private Offers or a managed reseller path? That impacts attribution in the sell-with flow.
- Demo tenant invite: Monica, can we do a short-lived IAM role for presales? Sarah, I'll send the invite file after you confirm the list of emails.

I'm copying AWS SellWith for the co-sell entitlements — they may want to pre-clear the demo path.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Channel Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sku-mapping-template.csv (2KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer

All —

Technical update from the integration side:
- Staging route: I've provisioned a demo tenant (demo-cloudscale-redwood) and created a routing rule that forwards private-offer traffic to a sandbox backend. I've dropped the invite stub in the Drive folder.
- Telemetry: we will add a lightweight tracer that surfaces marketplace SKU in request headers so we can attribute demo sessions.
- Entitlement mapping: two gaps to resolve (1) subscription renewal window mapping, (2) metered vs. flat-rate usage flags. We'll need Michael's pricing file to automate SKU mapping.

Ask: We recommend a 2-week paid retainer at the rates in the SOW for engineering availability — this covers the telemetry work and the final validation run with AWS/GCP contacts. If procurement needs an official SOW doc, I can convert the spreadsheet into a short Statement of Work.

[Attachment: demo-tenant-invite.txt (1KB)]

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Technical Integrations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudscale.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell interest + integration retainer — next steps

Thanks team — quick summary and next steps so everyone has the same view:

1) Evidence intake: Sarah to upload TLS chain, SOC-2 summary, and data retention doc to the shared Drive by EOD Mon 6/28. Redwood will validate and return any gap list by Tue 6/29.
2) SKU mapping: Michael to populate sku-mapping-template.csv; Ben will validate against private-offer flows by Wed 6/30.
3) Demo tenant: Olga's staging route is ready; Sarah to confirm presales list and we'll provision IAM roles this week.
4) Retainer SOW: we're proposing a 2-week engineering retainer (20 hours/week) at the rates in the attached SOW spreadsheet. Monica to send a short SOW/DocuSign for signature once Michael confirms pricing tiers.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm presales emails + upload evidence (due Mon 6/28)
- Michael: fill SKU template (due Tue 6/29)
- Ben: coordinate AWS SellWith pre-clear (in flight)
- Olga: prepare SOW docx for procurement (due Wed 6/30)

I'll generate the DocuSign link and HubSpot deal update after Michael populates the pricing. Thanks all — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Monica Patel
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
